scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Marriage for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Must have continuous membership of at least 3 years with the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Must have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year
Applicant must be a registered female member or the wife of a registered male member of the board
Must be a resident of Delhi
benefits_summary: Provides marriage assistance of ₹51,000 for female workers/daughters and ₹35,000 for male workers/sons.
documents_required: Employment Proof (including proof of 90 days employment)
